items.question: Can two partners who both menstruate use My Monthly?
items.answer: Absolutely! My Monthly is built to support all types of partnerships. The app now allows two people who experience a menstrual cycle to track and view each other's symptoms and receive tips on how you can support one another.

items.question: Are my health and data private and secure?
items.answer: Yes, they are. Your personal health and cycle data are encrypted using end-to-end industry standards. We never sell, rent, or monetize your health data to third parties or advertisers.

items.question: What should I do if my cycle is irregular?
items.answer: My Monthly is designed to adapt to irregular cycles. As you log your periods and daily symptoms over your 6 most recent cycles, our cycle prediction algorithm learns your unique patterns and adjusts its predictions dynamically rather than forcing a standard 28-day model.

items.question: What do I do if I'm paired with my partner, but we can't see each other's moods/cycle logs?
items.answer: If you ever encounter a problem, send us your log, and we'll do our best to resolve it! Head to Profile > scroll down to Report an Issue > and press Send.
